description: Update one calendar event by rescheduling it, changing status, reassigning it, or storing metadata.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID or backing scheduled post ID.

postId.description: Compatibility alias when the calendar event maps directly to a scheduled post.

scheduledAt.description: Updated ISO 8601 schedule time for the event.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

name: update_calendar_event
title: Update Calendar Event
